messages:
tom: heads-up: ap-ne1 cohort showing progressive NVMe write tail latency and a rise in block error counters. GPU attaches are queuing, backlog ~16 GPUs :grimacing:
infra-bot: [ALERT] region=ap-ne1 metric=nvme_write_tail_latency current=42ms threshold=25ms nodes=apn1-node-{07,08,12,18,19}
ayesha: seeing correlated network retransmits from the same hosts, might be a NIC offload/fanout issue aggravating the io stack
shiv: any recent cleaner / janitor waves or tenant jobs doing heavy tmp churn? small writes + metadata churn often hit older flash harder
tom: yes, cleaner started a large sweep at 02:40 local and we also had a rollout of telemetry-agent that enabled per-request checkpointing to /var/tmp. dmesg shows 'nvme0: I/O CRC error' on a couple nodes
megan: cost concern: stalled attaches mean queued jobs pay to wait. crude ballpark: 16 gpus * 30m ~ 480 gpu-minutes. tag finance for exact $ impact if we consider cross-region moves
finance-bot: noted. please include ticket link for chargeback review
ayesha: quick mitigation plan: (1) throttle cleaner parallelism for ap-ne1, (2) reduce telemetry-agent workers on the affected nodes, (3) increase /var/tmp retention to reduce churn
tom: applying conservative change now: set CLEANER_PARALLEL=2 and TELEMETRY_WORKERS=1 for daemonsets in ap-ne1. rolling update to 5 nodes
tom: command: kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/ephemeral-cleaner CLEANER_PARALLEL=2 --context=ap-ne1
tom: command: kubectl -n infra set env daemonset/telemetry-agent WORKERS=1 --context=ap-ne1
shiv: also add cleaner.flag=yield_to_attach=true so cleaner backs off if attach_backlog > 5
ayesha: good call. I'm patching the daemonset annotation to add yield flag for affected nodes
infra-bot: [METRIC] ap-ne1 nvme_write_tail_latency 1m=38ms 5m=41ms 15m=20ms
megan: any suggestion on cross-region fallback? eu-west1 has spare capacity but moving stateful pipelines is painful. prefer short mitigation first
tom: agree. risk window estimate: 30-90m to clear current backlog if throttles hold. escalate to rebalancing only if attach failure rate >20% for 30m
shiv: hardware note: this cohort shows elevated program/erase counts in HW telemetry. open a hardware-check ticket to verify if a subset of drives are degrading
ayesha: filing ticket: INFRA-6721 "ap-ne1 nvme tail-latency + attach sensitivity" assigned to eng-infra. owners: tom (monitoring), shiv (hw-telemetry), ayesha (runbook)
megan: include GPU-minute delta in the ticket (we'll use that for temporary credit if needed). also pre-approve up to 2h of cross-region shift if owners request
tom: monitoring: after throttles 1m latency dropped 38ms->24ms, attach backlog down to 7. keeping 2x canary nodes with original config for 30m to watch for regression
infra-bot: [ACTION] Created INFRA-6721 and attached graphs + last 100 dmesg lines
finance-bot: request received for cost analysis on INFRA-6721
shiv: follow-ups: (1) add attach-priority semaphore to cleaner, (2) add nvme_crc alert runbook, (3) propose default cleaner limits for cohorts with >1000 P/E cycles
ayesha: also planning scheduler change: stagger cleaner cron across node-ordinal with jitter to avoid cluster-wide waves
megan: ok. hold cross-region action unless we hit the escalation threshold. will standby for ticket updates
tom: thanks team. current status: nvme tail latency stable ~22-26ms, backlog trending down. will keep thread open for 60m then close if steady :thumbsup:
ayesha: good job, closing unless it flares back up :rocket:
